branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A square industrial cheese of about 2.3 kg, 25 cm a side, a Savencia trademark made from pasteurised cow's milk. It is ripened about two weeks, and has been made year-round in the Mayenne angevine area by the Perreault dairies since 1928.

sources.text: The milk, the ripening, the location and the format, from the article.
